sources.title: Wix CEO to employees: “I won’t pretend that we’re not looking at potential changes” | CTech
sources.description: Company reportedly preparing to cut 1,000 jobs as AI pressures mount.

sources.title: Wix to cut 1,000 jobs, nearly 20% of workforce, as AI takes over key roles
sources.description: The website-building company is reportedly restructuring around artificial intelligence tools as rising AI investments, mounting costs and broader tech sector pressures reshape hiring priorities.

sources.title: Wix lays off 1,000 workers as the AI jobs apocalypse keeps looking very real
sources.description: CEO Avishai Abrahami wrote on X that reducing the Wix team by 20%, or around 1,000 people, was a "hard decision" (four times).
